name: nsite-clay
description: A self-editable nsite. One HTML file that edits and republishes itself, hosted on Nostr.

scripts.test: node test/secret-files.mjs && node test/verify.mjs && node test/ai-client.mjs && node test/ai-workflows.mjs && node test/publisher-ai.mjs && node test/publisher-key.mjs && node test/vault.mjs && node test/cashu.mjs && node test/wallet.mjs && node test/e2e-ai.mjs && node test/ai-evaluation.mjs
scripts.site:build: node build.mjs && cp dist/nsite-clay.js dist/nsite-clay-source.js dist/nsite-clay-wallet.js site/ && cp templates/_shared/nsite-clay-base.css templates/_shared/nsite-clay-chrome.js site/ && cp icons/nsite-clay-transparent.png icons/nsite-clay-mark.svg icons/nsite-clay.png site/ && cp media/editing.png site/ && mkdir -p site/shots && cp media/guide/*.png site/shots/ && node tools/stage-templates.mjs && node tools/stage-deploy.mjs && node tools/stage-runtime.mjs
scripts.site:serve: npm run site:build && node -e "const{createServer}=require('node:http'),{readFileSync,statSync}=require('node:fs'),{join,extname}=require('node:path');const T={'.html':'text/html','.js':'text/javascript','.css':'text/css','.png':'image/png','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.md':'text/markdown'};createServer((q,s)=>{let p=join('site',decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]));try{if(statSync(p).isDirectory())p=join(p,'index.html')}catch{}try{const b=readFileSync(p);s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':T[extname(p)]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(b)}catch{s.writeHead(404);s.end('not found')}}).listen(4780,()=>console.log('site/ on http://127.0.0.1:4780/ (site root = server root, as a gateway serves it)'))"
scripts.demo:build: node build.mjs && rm -rf demo-dist && mkdir -p demo-dist && cp demo/index.html demo-dist/ && cp dist/nsite-clay.js demo-dist/ && cp templates/_shared/nsite-clay-base.css templates/_shared/nsite-clay-chrome.js demo-dist/
scripts.demo:serve: npm run demo:build && node -e "const{createServer}=require('node:http'),{readFileSync,statSync}=require('node:fs'),{join,extname}=require('node:path');const T={'.html':'text/html','.js':'text/javascript','.css':'text/css'};createServer((q,s)=>{let p=join('demo-dist',decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]));try{if(statSync(p).isDirectory())p=join(p,'index.html')}catch{}try{const b=readFileSync(p);s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':T[extname(p)]||'application/octet-stream','Cache-Control':'no-store'});s.end(b)}catch{s.writeHead(404);s.end('not found')}}).listen(4790,()=>console.log('demo on http://127.0.0.1:4790/'))"
